author: Huawei
description:
As traffic volumes rise, urban ports are busier than ever. Fast, reliable logistics and coordination are critical. A new edge AI system from students at Spain's Polytechnic University of Valencia is designed to improve port access efficiency and prevent bottlenecks.
 
Built with #Huawei's ModelArts and MindSpore, Virtual Doors improves port access by coordinating gates and reducing waiting times. It uses computer vision and predictive analytics to detect vehicles, validate access data, and manage traffic flow.
 
At the Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final, the Virtual Doors team said it aims to scale the system across port cities worldwide. The competition showcased real-world skills and innovation shaping the ICT industry. Student finalists from around the world competed and connected through workshops in Shenzhen. Explore more: https://bit.ly/49PSMsc #ICTheFuture
title: Student Team Designs Predictive AI System to Optimize Port Operations

author: Huawei
description:
Agentic operations are reshaping the telecom industry. The Operations Transformation Forum will discuss how to use AI agents to transform product and service operations, experience, O&M, and customer retention, which will reshape the user lifecycle.

#OTF2026 Advancing Agentic Operations, hosted by #Huawei and TM Forum, takes place 22–24 June in Copenhagen, Denmark. The forum brings together operators and partners to share the latest best practices and innovation scenarios.

Gain practical insights and definitive blueprints from telecom leaders at OTF2026. Learn more: https://bit.ly/440FAgK #DTWignite2026
title: Join OTF2026 in Copenhagen: Advancing Agentic Operations

author: Huawei
description:
Grading assignments can take hours. A new AI-powered platform from Singapore helps teachers deliver faster, more consistent feedback while improving student outcomes.
 
Remarkably, built on #Huawei Cloud with ModelArts and OCR, analyzes handwritten and typed essays to provide detailed, personalized feedback. It enables grading workflows up to 7x faster and helps teachers save more than 10 hours per cycle, while supporting measurable student improvement.
 
Remarkably was introduced by a team from the National University of Singapore at the Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final. The competition provides a global platform for innovation. The 10th Huawei ICT Competition drew an event record 220,000 participants from over 100 countries and regions. Learn more: https://bit.ly/49PSMsc #ICTheFuture
title: Singapore Students Build Faster, Smarter Grading Platform

author: Huawei
description:
Healthcare is shifting toward proactive monitoring. Dockify, an AI-powered health companion, analyzes biometric data to detect early risk signals and support elderly care and chronic disease management.
 
Built with #Huawei technologies like MindSpore and openGauss, Dockify connects wearable data and health profiles to deliver real-time alerts and predictive insights. It enables faster response, stronger community support, and more accessible care for users and families.
 
The Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final provides a platform for teams like Kazakhstan's Dockify to showcase solutions addressing global challenges. The competition enables students and teachers to build ICT skills and foster innovation. Discover more: https://bit.ly/49PSMsc #ICTheFuture
title: Dockify Enables Proactive Health Monitoring for Daily Care
